n, k = map(int, input().split())
digits = []
while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % k)
    n //= k
length = len(digits)
MOD = 1000000007

# Initialize the base matrix
mat = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
for j in range(k + 1):
    mat[0][j] = 1
    mat[j][j] = 1

# Precompute matrices for each digit position
matrices = [mat]
for i in range(1, length):
    prev = matrices[i - 1]
    newMat = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for x in range(k + 1):
        for y in range(k + 1):
            for z in range(k + 1):
                newMat[x][z] = (newMat[x][z] + prev[x][y] * mat[y][z]) % MOD
    matrices.append(newMat)

res = 1
offset = 0
for i in range(length - 1, -1, -1):
    digit = digits[i]
    for j in range(digit):
        for x in range(k + 1):
            res = (res * matrices[i][(x + offset) % k][k]) % MOD
        offset = (offset + j) % k

print(res % MOD)
